about_short_description.short_description: Clipboard Health is a marketplace where nurses and CNAs can search for jobs, and where healthcare facilities can fill open shifts.

product.name: Clipboard Health Marketplace
product.description: An online platform connecting healthcare professionals with healthcare facilities to fill open shifts efficiently.

product.name: InstantPay
product.description: A payment service that enables healthcare professionals to receive payment immediately after submitting their timesheet for a completed shift.

product.name: License Manager
product.description: A tool for healthcare professionals to upload, verify, and manage multiple professional licenses to access a wider range of shifts.

product.name: Urgent Shifts
product.description: A feature that identifies last-minute staffing needs and notifies qualified professionals with incentives to fill urgent shifts quickly.

product.name: Priority Access
product.description: A system that grants highly-rated healthcare professionals early access to shifts at facilities where they are favored, improving shift booking opportunities.

product.name: Timesheets 2.0: Digital Timesheets and Auto-Verification
product.description: A digital timekeeping system that enables on-site clock-in/out and automatic verification of completed shifts to streamline payroll and reduce errors.
